newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan poll on constitutional reform closes.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan poll on constitutional reform closes.

text.p: Polling stations for a referendum on constitutional reform closed across Morocco at 6 p.m. (1800 GMT) on Friday, an interior ministry spokesman said.
Provisional figures showed that one hour before the booths closed, more than 80 percent of 12 million eligible voters had cast their ballots, the official added.
The referendum is to change the 1992 constitution, and set up a second house of parliament to strengthen regional representation.
